WITH circuit_averages AS (
  SELECT r.circuitId, c.country, AVG(r.round) AS avg_round
  FROM races AS r
  JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  GROUP BY r.circuitId, c.country
),
country_averages AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(r.round) AS country_avg_round
  FROM races AS r
  JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  GROUP BY country
)
SELECT ca.circuitId, ca.country, ca.avg_round,
       ca.avg_round - coa.country_avg_round AS difference
FROM circuit_averages AS ca
JOIN country_averages AS coa ON coa.country = ca.country
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
